title: MathArena: Evaluating LLMs on Uncontaminated Math Competitions
abstract: arXiv:2505.23281v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The rapid advancement of reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs) has led to notable improvements on mathematical benchmarks. However, many of the most commonly used evaluation datasets (e.g., AIME 2024) are widely available online, making it difficult to disentangle genuine reasoning from potential memorization. Furthermore, these benchmarks do not evaluate proof-writing capabilities, which are crucial for many mathematical tasks. To address this, we introduce MathArena, a new benchmark based on the following key insight: recurring math competitions provide a stream of high-quality, challenging problems that can be used for real-time evaluation of LLMs. By evaluating models as soon as new problems are released, we effectively eliminate the risk of contamination. translated_title: MathArena：在无污染数学竞赛上评估大语言模型
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的快速发展使其在数学基准测试上取得了显著进步。然而，许多最常用的评估数据集（例如 AIME 2024）在网上广泛可得，这使得很难将真正的推理能力与潜在的“记忆”区分开来。此外，这些基准测试无法评估证明写作能力，而证明写作对许多数学任务至关重要。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 MathArena，一个基于以下关键洞察的新型基准：定期举办的数学竞赛提供了源源不断的高质量、高难度题目，可用于对 LLM 进行实时评估。通过在新题目发布后立即评估模型，我们有效地消除了数据污染的风险。使用该框架，我们发现了 AIME 2024 存在数据污染的强烈迹象。尽管如此，在更难的竞赛（如 CMIMC 2025）上的评估表明……
tldr: 提出 MathArena 基准，利用定期举办的数学竞赛在新题发布后立即评估大语言模型，有效消除数据污染风险，并发现 AIME 2024 存在明显的污染迹象。
